plain: A formula that works back from an imperfect judge's pass rate to the true rate, using its known error rates.
eli5: If your scale always adds two kilos, take two kilos off to get your real weight.
technical: Rogan and Gladen (1978): since measured = (1 − spec) + J·true, invert to estimate true prevalence. Requires sens and spec to hold on this population; undefined at J = 0, and estimates can fall outside [0, 1].
